searchText: Just to add the values are unsafe because of the precision loss in the 'number' package after 52 bits, slowness might not be reason behind it. You could do modulus 'Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER' I was only using the website temporarily, it was a curiosity only. I'm testing against the spec test vectors and most will not be parsed by that site https://ethresear.ch/t/targeting-zero-mev-a-content-layer-solution/9224 What are your thoughts on this? Has performance costs associated with it and, IIUC, it can be defeated by block stuffing which is very unhealthy for the network.
